title: Two types of commandments: chukkim (statutes) and mishpatim (ordinances)
summary: Explains two types of commandments, chukkim (statutes) and mishpatim (ordinances). A statute (chok) is a commandment whose rationale escapes us; an ordinance is one whose rationale is understandable, such as no murder or no stealing. The words chukkim, statute and chok are in blue.

text.text: A “statute” (chok) is a commandment whose rationale escapes us.
An “ordinance” is one whose rationale is understandable (no murder, no stealing, etc.)

words.gloss: statutes: commandments whose rationale escapes us
ordinances: commandments whose rationale is understandable
